structuralFindings: FLAT, YEAR-ROUND rate — no Peak/Shoulder/Green or any season structure at all. Confirmed explicitly by the document's own validity line: 'valid from 01.01.2026 - 31.12.2026', one price for the whole year.

Base meal plan choice is Bed & Breakfast or Half Board — no Full Board or All-Inclusive option offered at all.
A 'Dayroom (refreshing)' rate exists — a day-use room, separate product from an overnight stay.
Property has only 8.5 rooms total (stated literally as '8,5' in the source table) — a very small inventory; flag for availability awareness on any multi-pax quote.
